comparison.objective: Candidate installs and recovers temporary lifting hardware; record places and spot-welds a nickel strip onto battery cells.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests close-clearance pin insertion, button-actuated ball locking, shackle lifting, seating, and extraction; record tests thin-strip placement and two-probe welding-tool contact.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires verified retention, suspended lift, three-pad support, unloaded withdrawal, clearance, and damage gates; record requires four welds, tool return, stillness, and pack integrity.
